description: Valid create returns 201 with code, shortUrl, expiresAt, ownerToken, 7-char alnum unique codes and Location header
Missing, empty or malformed url returns 400 problem details
Alias my-link returns 201 with code my-link; duplicate returns 409; My-Link is distinct (case-sensitive)
Too short, too long and illegal-character aliases return 400
Future expiry redirects 302 until the time then 410; metadata isExpired flips
Link without expiresAt still redirects after ten years
Bad schemes, userinfo and over-2048-char URLs return 400
localhost, loopback, private, link-local and IPv6 hosts return 400
Active link gives 302 with Location equal to target
Unknown code gives 404 and deactivated link gives 410
Metadata returns 200 with required fields and no owner token; unknown code 404
N redirects yield totalClicks N with lastClickAt and daily clicks
404/410 do not count; unknown analytics code returns 404
Correct bearer token returns 204; then redirect 410 and isActive false
Missing/wrong token rejected leaving link active; unknown code 404
Other client unaffected, window reset allows creation, redirects not throttled
